ticket.subject: Exports broken AGAIN
ticket.body: Third time this month the scheduled PDF export to our board has failed. Dashboards themselves load fine. If this is not fixed before our renewal next month we will move to another tool. Also please refund the September charge, we did not get what we paid for.

criteria.billing: Invoices, charges, plans and refund requests, even when the refund is because of a bug
criteria.bug: Something in Lumen is broken or gives wrong results, and no refund is asked for
criteria.account_access: Sign-in, passwords, two-factor and user permissions
criteria.feature_request: Asks for something Lumen does not do today
criteria.other: Anything else: sales, partnerships, spam, or no clear request

impact.instructions: How much does the problem in state.ticket stop the customer from using Lumen?
criteria: No problem with Lumen itself: a question, a request or an admin task
A minor feature is broken or awkward; there is an easy way around it
An important feature is broken; the rest of Lumen works
The customer cannot use Lumen at all

cancel_threat.instructions: Does state.ticket threaten to stop using Lumen?
